subject: Re: Evidence request - ephemeral secrets & pre-deploy gating (SOC 2)
messages:
From: Sigma Assessors <assess@sigma-audit.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Evidence request - ephemeral secrets & pre-deploy gating (SOC 2)

Hi Vivek,

We're working through the SOC 2 scoping for Gamma Payments and need to validate controls around secrets management and deployment gating for code that handles payment data. Specifically could you provide the following artifacts for the period 2025-10-01 to 2025-11-01:

- Design/diagram describing the ephemeral secrets workflow (Vault, agents, TTLs).
- Vault policy(s) used for CI runners and deploy agents (policy names and attached roles).
- CI pipeline snippet showing how secrets are retrieved for build/deploy and any short-lived credential exchange.
- Evidence of PR gating: a small export of PR review approvals and branch protection enforcement (sample PRs ok).
- Change approval runbook or checklist used for production deploys.
- Audit log export showing Vault token creation/renewal and any admin overrides for the period above.

If you can attach the artifacts or share a secure Drive folder we can review. Also let us know if you can demo the workflow (20–30 mins) — that is often the fastest way to verify ephemeral token issuance.

Please send by EOD Tue 20 Nov if possible.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Sigma Assessors
assess@sigma-audit.com

[This is a formal evidence request for SOC 2 scoping with Gamma Payments]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sigma Assessors <assess@sigma-audit.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request - ephemeral secrets & pre-deploy gating (SOC 2)

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble the package and can provide both redacted logs and a sanitized live demo. Quick notes on scope:

- Artifacts we'll include: Vault policies (PDF), CI pipeline gate config (YAML), PR review export (CSV), audit-log export (CSV), PR template and the change approval runbook (MD).
- For the audit logs we can provide a CSV export covering token create/renew/revoke events plus a small sample of admin overrides. If you need raw timestamps we can provide them, otherwise we can deliver redacted versions.
- We use HashiCorp Vault with dynamic AWS role exchange for short-lived creds; TTLs are typically 15m for deploy agents and 1h for CI ephemeral sessions — we'll document the mapping to control IDs (CC: SOC 2 CC6.3/CC7.1).

Can you confirm whether redacted logs are acceptable, or do you require the original identifiers? Also propose a demo slot: Thu 20 Nov 11:00–11:30 PT. If that works I will send a calendar invite and create a temporary auditor token scoped to a sandbox project for the demo.

Attaching a quick index of what we'll upload.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
[Attachment index: ephemeral-vault-policy.pdf; ci-predeploy-gate-config.yaml; pr-template.md]

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 19 Nov 2025 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Evidence request - pulling artifacts

Vivek / Neha — attaching the exports I pulled this morning. Notes below.

Attachments: pr-review-export.csv; audit-log-export-2025-10-01_2025-11-01.csv; ci-gate-screenshot.png

- PR export: includes PR numbers 3421, 3490 (payment-routing change) and 3512 (hotfix). Each row has approvals and reviewer names; branch-protection enforcement is visible in the `mergeable_state` column.
- Audit log: filtered to Vault token lifecycle events (create/renew/revoke) and annotated with token_ttl and requestor role. I redacted internal hostnames as per our evidence-sharing practice.
- CI screenshot: shows the pre-deploy gate step failing when required approvals are not present (this demonstrates enforcement).

I also included the CI gate YAML snippet that references our Vault agent invocation and the role-based exchange (see ci-predeploy-gate-config.yaml). If you want full raw logs, say the word and I'll coordinate a secure S3 transfer.

—Dev
Senior SRE
Redwood Inference

Thanks Vivek / Dev — that looks like the right set. A couple quick clarifications before the demo:

- For the audit log CSV, can you include the full request_id column (we'll redact on our side if needed)? It helps us match events to CI runs.
- For the demo we want to observe: (a) issuance of a short-lived token for a CI job, (b) the branch protection/pre-deploy gate blocking a merge without review, and (c) a sample revoke/rotation flow. A sandbox token for the demo is perfect.

Thu 20 Nov 11:00 PT works — please send calendar invite and the temporary token details in a separate secure email or via the Drive folder with limited access.

Best,
Alex Rivera
Sigma Assessors
